meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context. Before persisting these findings, read only the two assigned source-only packets and project review instructions. Did not open author batches, author notes, starters, models, criteria, previous reviews or the catalogue.

tone_balance.scope_note: This packet contributes 1 lightly humorous items among its 9 items. Across both reviewed open-task packets there are 15 ordinary items and 3 lightly humorous items. The coordinator must independently add the other 18 A1 items and check five lightly humorous tasks across the 36-item program. This packet stays within the small-batch upward-rounded cap of two.

limitations: Stage 1 only. No criteria, models, samples, starters, metadata, author notes or catalogue diversity have been reviewed.
No rendered images or audio were inspected. Picture findings concern only the supplied briefs and alts.
Editorial judgments concern the A1 foundation target and do not validate CEFR difficulty or exam equivalence.

meaning.situation_summary: At work, the learner finds a banana in the lunch bag, wants bread with lunch and expects Julio later.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Tell the arriving person what is already in the bag and ask him to bring bread.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Julio’s stated later arrival gives the request a practical use. The banana and empty plate fit a work lunch. The task does not need an unstated shopping trip or a second person at the table.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A short message to Julio is useful because he will arrive later and can bring the requested bread. He is absent from the picture, and the prompt establishes why the learner contacts him.
meaning.tone_reason: A banana in a lunch bag and a request for bread are ordinary lunch planning.

two_tiny_goals: Name the food in the pictured bag.
items.picture_text_check: The bag visibly contains a banana. The alt preserves that fact. ‘De lunchtas’ names the already established container and does not identify its contents.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: De lunchtas
source_evidence.prompt: U bent op het werk. Julio komt straks. U wilt brood bij uw lunch. Kijk naar het plaatje. Schrijf Julio een bericht. Zeg wat er in uw tas zit. Vraag hem om brood mee te nemen.
source_evidence.image_alt: Op een tafel op het werk staat een open tas met een banaan. Ernaast staat een leeg bord.

meaning.situation_summary: The learner buys an apple, then opens the shopping bag at home and sees an onion.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Report the received food to the shop and ask for the apple that was bought.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The stated purchase and pictured contents establish a mismatch. Reporting it and asking for the intended item follows directly. The learner need not invent how the error happened.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The learner is already home, so a message to the shop is a natural way to report the contents and request the intended item. The recipient is the business involved in the stated purchase.
meaning.tone_reason: A wrong grocery item is an ordinary service problem. The picture adds no absurd object or action.

two_tiny_goals: Name what is in the bag.
Ask the shop for an apple.
items.picture_text_check: The onion’s skin and shape are specified clearly in the brief, and the alt preserves the onion. The title leaves the food unidentified.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Een tas van de winkel
source_evidence.prompt: U koopt een appel in de winkel. Thuis opent u de tas. Kijk naar het plaatje. Schrijf de winkel een bericht. Zeg wat er in de tas zit. Vraag om een appel.
source_evidence.image_alt: Thuis kijkt een klant naar een ui in een papieren tas.

meaning.situation_summary: Roos has a birthday tomorrow, the learner will have breakfast at her home, and she sends a cake photo.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Respond to the photo with an opinion and tell the breakfast host a drink preference.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The birthday and breakfast establish why Roos sends the photo and why a drink preference is useful. An ordinary small cake at a birthday breakfast is plausible. Both requested statements stay brief.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The learner replies by message to Roos, who has just sent a photo and will host the stated breakfast. The prompt gives both the recipient and the occasion.
meaning.tone_reason: The cake and breakfast foods have normal proportions. A birthday cake at breakfast does not make the scene absurd.

two_tiny_goals: Say what the learner thinks of the cake.
items.picture_text_check: The brief and alt agree on a small cake at a kitchen table with a cup and bread. The learner chooses an opinion and drink, so no hidden picture answer is needed.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Bij Roos
source_evidence.prompt: Roos is morgen jarig. U gaat bij haar ontbijten. Ze stuurt u een foto van haar taart. Schrijf Roos een bericht. Zeg wat u van de taart vindt. Zeg wat u wilt drinken. Kies zelf een drankje.
source_evidence.image_alt: Roos staat aan een keukentafel met een kleine taart, een kop en een bord met brood.

meaning.situation_summary: The learner plans to make music at home tomorrow, and Modibo can join.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Invite Modibo to the music session and ask him to bring a guitar.
meaning.coherence_explanation: A music invitation and an instrument request belong to one plan. The pictured guitar playing matches that plan. The source establishes live music directly, so an instrument needs no invented explanation.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A message to Modibo is a natural invitation for a future activity and communicates what to bring. The prompt does not place him beside the learner.
meaning.tone_reason: Playing an ordinary guitar at home and inviting another person are everyday activities.

two_tiny_goals: Ask Modibo to come make music.
Ask him to bring a guitar.
items.picture_text_check: The picture supports music at home with a normal acoustic guitar. Both message goals come from the prompt. ‘Muziek thuis’ leaves the requested invitation and request to the learner.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Muziek thuis
source_evidence.prompt: U maakt morgen thuis muziek. Modibo kan meedoen. Schrijf hem een bericht. Vraag hem om bij u muziek te maken. Vraag hem om een gitaar mee te nemen.
source_evidence.image_alt: Een vrouw zit thuis op een stoel en speelt gitaar.

meaning.situation_summary: The learner will show a film in the garden tonight at nine, and Sabrina asks where and when.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Reply to Sabrina’s two practical questions about the film.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Sabrina’s explicit question creates the reason to provide the two details. The screen and projector in the brief make the outdoor film setup coherent without an invented device.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A message directly answers Sabrina’s stated question. The recipient and information need are explicit, and no co-present person is asked to read a message about what she already sees.
meaning.tone_reason: A garden film screening with an ordinary screen and projector is a plausible leisure event.

items.picture_text_check: The garden and screening equipment support the prompt. The title names only the general event; the learner must still supply where and when.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Vanavond een film
source_evidence.prompt: U kijkt vanavond een film in uw tuin. De film begint om negen uur. Sabrina vraagt waar en hoe laat. Schrijf haar een bericht. Zeg waar de film is. Zeg hoe laat de film begint.
source_evidence.image_alt: Een vrouw zit in een tuin voor een groot wit doek tussen twee bomen.

meaning.situation_summary: Julio wants to cycle with the learner tomorrow, and they will eat together during the trip.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Confirm participation and coordinate the food the learner will bring.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Confirming a cycling plan and naming food for the stated shared meal serve the same outing. The bicycle and small bag fit travel. No food must be inferred from a closed bag.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A message to Julio confirms his stated proposed outing and helps plan the shared meal. The picture shows Julio with his bicycle and does not place the learner next to him.
meaning.tone_reason: An ordinary bicycle outing with food along the way is everyday leisure.

two_tiny_goals: Say that the learner will join.
items.picture_text_check: The ordinary bicycle and bag fit the trip. Food is explicitly self-chosen, so the learner is not asked to identify hidden contents. The title does not complete either message goal.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Samen fietsen
source_evidence.prompt: Julio wil morgen met u fietsen. U eet onderweg samen. Schrijf Julio een bericht. Zeg dat u meegaat. Zeg welk eten u meeneemt. Kies zelf iets te eten.
source_evidence.image_alt: Julio staat met zijn fiets op een binnenplaats. Achter op de fiets zit een tas.

meaning.situation_summary: The teacher sends a classroom photo and lets the learner choose a chair for tomorrow; the learner wants the blue chair.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Identify the preferred chair and ask the teacher whether it remains available.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The explicit advance choice explains contacting the teacher about a chair. Stating a preference before checking its availability is a coherent reservation exchange. The task needs no invented disability, seating rule or classroom event.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A message replies to the teacher’s photo and invitation to choose for tomorrow. The learner has a reason to ask this recipient about availability before attending class.
meaning.tone_reason: The photo shows ordinary classroom chairs. Advance selection is expressly part of the situation and contains no comic action.

two_tiny_goals: Say that the learner wants the blue chair.
Ask whether that chair is still free.
items.picture_text_check: The blue foreground chair and grey second chair support the selection. The alt preserves both colours. The required preferred colour is already stated in the prompt, so this is a short message task rather than a concealed visual test.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Een stoel voor morgen
source_evidence.prompt: De docent stuurt een foto van de klas. U mag nu een stoel kiezen voor morgen. U wilt de blauwe stoel. Schrijf de docent een bericht. Zeg welke stoel u wilt. Vraag of die stoel nog vrij is.
source_evidence.image_alt: In een klas staat een blauwe stoel bij een tafel. Verderop staat een grijze stoel.

meaning.situation_summary: The learner receives an oversized parcel containing a spoon, and Roos asks what is inside.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Answer Roos’s contents question and add a reaction to the conspicuous box.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Roos’s explicit contents question motivates the reply. An observation or opinion about exaggerated packaging follows naturally from the same parcel; no extra event or motive is required.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A short message answers Roos’s stated question. She is not shown beside the learner, and the learner has information from opening the parcel to share.
meaning.tone_reason: A single spoon inside an enormous delivery box is a clear visual joke about excessive packaging.

two_tiny_goals: Name the spoon inside the box.
Say what the learner thinks of the box.
items.picture_text_check: The brief makes the spoon recognisable despite the large box and the alt includes both facts. ‘Het pakket’ does not give the contents or the learner’s opinion.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Het pakket
source_evidence.prompt: U krijgt een pakket. Roos vraagt wat er in de doos zit. Kijk naar het plaatje. Schrijf haar een bericht. Zeg wat er in de doos zit. Zeg wat u van de doos vindt.
source_evidence.image_alt: Een vrouw kijkt in een heel grote open doos. Midden in de doos ligt één lepel.

meaning.situation_summary: The learner is at home and receives a photo of Sabrina drawing a flower in an art class.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Respond to Sabrina’s shared photo and request another photo.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The received photo supplies a natural reason for a short social reply. Giving an opinion and asking for another photo stay within the same exchange. No particular opinion or unseen relationship must be invented.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The prompt explicitly separates the learner at home from Sabrina in her class. Messaging is the established medium for responding to the photo.
meaning.tone_reason: An adult drawing a flower in a class is an ordinary hobby scene.

two_tiny_goals: Say what the learner thinks of the photo.
items.picture_text_check: The brief and alt agree on Sabrina drawing a flower in class. The learner chooses an opinion; the title introduces the sender without completing either speech act.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

source_evidence.title: Een foto van Sabrina
source_evidence.prompt: U bent thuis. Sabrina stuurt u een foto uit haar tekenles. Schrijf Sabrina een bericht. Zeg wat u van de foto vindt. Vraag om nog een foto.
source_evidence.image_alt: Sabrina zit in een klas en tekent een bloem op papier.
